result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_avg_clustering_coefficient()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get average clustering coefficient for the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L13247-L13310){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_avg_clustering_coefficient() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Average clustering coefficient](/assets/graphs/get-avg-clustering-coefficient.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="A five-node graph with two triangles in the accent color. Badges give each node's local clustering coefficient: A 1, B 0.67, C 0.67, D 0.33, E 0. The card sums them to 2.667 over 5 nodes, an average of 0.533." width="100%"} Returns the mean of all node clustering coefficients. This is a global measure of how clustered the graph is overall. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Average clustering coefficient (`0.0` to `1.0`). ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Averaging the local clustering coefficient across every node gives what Watts and Strogatz (1998) named the network's clustering coefficient. Values near $1$ signal a graph whose neighborhoods are almost cliques (dense triangular closure); values near $0$ point to tree-like or otherwise sparse structure with few triangles. Small-world networks sit at the combination that made them famous: high average clustering paired with a small average shortest-path length. Note that this simple mean weights every node equally regardless of degree; for a degree-weighted version see `get_transitivity()`. ## Examples {.doc-examples} Compare clustering in different graph types: ::: {#16852475 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec triangle = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "A") ) # Returns 1.00 (highly clustered) triangle.get_avg_clustering_coefficient() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1.0 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#bdb73675 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Star graph: not clustered star = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="center") .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("center", "A") .add_edge("center", "B") .add_edge("center", "C") ) # Returns 0.00 (not clustered) star.get_avg_clustering_coefficient() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 0.0 ``` ::: :::
